rule: development-only tooling, installed into the lab venv AFTER the LAB-01 pin. It is deliberately NOT in configs/requirements.lock: the runtime baseline is what a confirmation run reproduces, and a lint tool must never be part of it.
constraints: no module under src/crypto_regime_lab may import these
they may not appear in configs/requirements.lock
the engine pin quantbt-engine==1.1.1 / quantbt-native==0.4.2 is unchanged

pyflakes.purpose: static check for dead code, unused imports and undefined names

autoflake.purpose: removes the unused imports pyflakes reports
